stations.title: Imran
stations.say: Can the list be read in one place?
stations.note: He fixed one copy last month.

stations.title: The scripts
stations.text: Each one reads plots.txt its own way.

stations.title: Every script
stations.text: One fix reaches all of them.

captions: At Marrowfield, Imran asks for the plot list to be read in one place.
Each script reads plots.txt its own way, so his fix for Windows files reached only one.
You write one module that reads the list, and scripts that use it, in four tasks.
Now every script imports readPlots, so one fix reaches all of them.
Same plot list, one way to read it. Imran knows which version he has, too.
